title: Q-AUDIT-repo-conform: fm-repo-nonconformant failing (fail): Read python3 seed/scripts/repoconform.py --fleet doctrine/fleet-map.json (the platform command for the same reader is python3 -m foundation repoconform, foundation/repoconform.py):
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe repo-conform
**Status:** open

Failure mode `fm-repo-nonconformant` detected by `repo-conform`, failing since 2026-11-27T15:54:21Z.
Evidence: ble ok
  repoconform: 17/17 files conform
repoconform: ultrastable/unlearn ok
  repoconform: 18/18 files conform
repoconform: ultrastable/what-works ok
  repoconform: 18/18 files conform
repoconform: fleet 11/12 repositories conform; ultrastable/ops unmeasured: cannot read the repository (HTTP 404)

Signature: 0453042fc9c4 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a repository in the fleet map carries a machine-readable file (AGENTS.md, llms.txt, LICENSE and LICENSES/, REUSE.toml, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml, catalog-info.yaml, ultrastable.json, EditorConfig, Dependabot, devcontainer, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY) that is missing, fails its own standard or differs from what its manifest renders, or the repository cannot be read
Remedy: Read python3 seed/scripts/repoconform.py --fleet doctrine/fleet-map.json (the platform command for the same reader is python3 -m foundation repoconform, foundation/repoconform.py): each line names the repository, the file, its validator and why. The last line lists each repository that does not conform with its file score and failing files. Fix the file in that repository's own pull request: render the generated ones with the kit's surfaces.py --render (scripts/surfaces.py in a seeded system, vendor/ultrastable/tools/surfaces.py in a tenant, seed/scripts/surfaces.py in the core; each failing line names the one for its repository), fix the manifest or generator for the rest. An unmeasured repository needs a read route (the lane's token for a private one), never a pass. Never relax a validator to clear a reading.
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe repo-conform
